name: Alchemical Breath
body:
Drawbacks
Alchemical Breath
Source Kobolds of Golarion pg. 19
Category Race
Requirement(s) Kobold
Your tribe, in an effort to emulate the green chromatic dragons they admire, goes to great lengths to secure alchemical coal (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Race Guide 135). As a member of a green kobold tribe, you begin play with three pieces of the choking smoke variety of alchemical coal. Eating one of these pellets allows you to exhale noxious vapors, damaging and sickening your enemies. These pellets do not count against your starting character wealth.
